title: Associate, Data Science
job_description: Your team The future of accounting and advisory is rapidly evolving with new technologies. Our Data Science team is at the forefront of this transformation, working on exciting real-world projects in automation, analytics, data visualization, artificial intelligence and application development. We develop tools and solutions that enhance our work efficiency and provide fresh insights to our clients. Most importantly, we help our people build the skills needed to stay future-ready. Your responsibilities As a team member in the Data Science team, you will be part of an energetic group driving the organization's data and technology agenda. You will have the opportunity to innovate new platforms that automate business processes, lead data analytics projects, and contribute to initiatives that strengthen our data and technology ecosystem. This role focuses on streamlining and digitalising and involves the use of several techniques such as automation, analytics, data visualisation and intelligent systems development. You will gain hands-on experience with cutting-edge tools while collaborating with professionals across service lines to solve real business challenges. Key areas: Design and develop automation workflows to improve business efficiency. Create dashboards and visualizations to effectively communicate insights. Research and deploy new tools or platforms to enhance existing business processes. Collaborate with stakeholders to identify and build data-driven solutions for business pain points. Conduct quantitative and qualitative analyses of client data to generate actionable insights. Your attributes We are looking for team members who are curious, driven, and passionate about data science and technology. You don’t need to be an expert — what matters most is your willingness to learn and contribute. The following qualities and experiences will be valuable: Passionate about data science and technology. Driven, inquisitive, and self-motivated. Able to work under pressure and meet tight deadlines. Strong problem-solving and analytical thinking. Good communication skills and ability to work collaboratively. Demonstrated competency in any of the following areas will be advantageous: Coding experience (e.g. Python) Workflow automation and deployment (e.g., Alteryx or similar platforms) Business Intelligence tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, or similar) Microsoft Power Platform (e.g., Power Query, Power Automate)
